verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments SaaS platform, and a portal-embedded AI assistant is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents payments, onboarding, webhooks, components and APIs, but nothing shows a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file only exposes docs in a machine-readable form; it is not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
